svg.title: Track (tp::track): the soil along the track, sampled at setup

g.text: Track (tp::track): the soil along the track, sampled at setup
x from the start line (the sled's rear wheels at the start);
profiles hold their end values beyond their ends;
in the step: a lookup and a blend of two samples, no soil model;
hard spots laid from their seed at setup (xorshift), the same on
every platform, over the first 200 m: surface_at() evaluates the
spot under x exactly (a binary search) for its drag_scale
